regions.text: 穏ての可能な場合とその事象の生起する偶然な場合との間に存する数量防開保といふことに壺きてるる。

quote.translation: Its concern is exhausted by the quantitative relation between all the possible cases of an event's occurring or not occurring and the contingent cases in which it does occur.

regions.text: しかも理論上の数量的開係は無験上には観測の同数を無隈に大にした場合に初めて妥當性をもち待るのであるから確率論は偶然的事象の生起する敷量前開係の理念的恆常性を巨視的に規定しょうとするに過ぎない。

quote.translation: Moreover, since a theoretical quantitative relation acquires empirical validity only when the number of observations is made infinitely large, probability theory seeks to do no more than determine, at the macroscopic level, the ideal constancy of the quantitative relations among contingent events.

regions.text: 微視なる細目に存する偶然前可變性は少しも觸れられない。

quote.translation: The contingent variability that resides in the microscopic details is left untouched.

regions.text: しかも偶然の偶然たる所以はまさに細目の動きに存してゐる。

quote.translation: Yet it is in the movement of the details that the contingent is contingent.

regions.text: 一要するに、確率論とは偶然そのものの考究ではない。「偶然の「計算」をさへも云へない。偶然そのものは計算は出來ない。

quote.translation: Probability theory, in short, is no inquiry into the contingent itself, and it cannot even be called a "calculation" of "the contingent", for the contingent as such cannot be calculated.

regions.text: 確率論が一定の視角に於て偶然性へ斜視を投げることによつてその構造を或度まで目撃させることは否むことはできないが偶然性の全貌に開して何等の把握を許すものではない。

quote.translation: It would be wrong to deny that probability theory, casting a sidelong glance at contingency from a fixed angle of vision, allows us to witness something of its structure, but it permits no grasp of contingency as a whole.

regions.text: 量子力學的理論が偶然性を間題とすると考へる者があるかも知れない。

quote.translation: Some may think that quantum theory takes contingency as its problem.

regions.text: しかし量子力學の理論は最子力學的現象として位置と速度との雨條件を同時に決定し得ないことを断定し、従つて或度の偶然性の支配を許容するだけのことである。

quote.translation: Quantum mechanics asserts that, for quantum phenomena, the two conditions of position and velocity cannot be determined at the same time, and in doing so it merely permits a certain degree of contingency to hold sway.

regions.text: その謂はゆる不確定性原理は偶然性を單に原理として承認してるるに過ぎない。最子

quote.translation: Its so-called uncertainty principle does no more than acknowledge contingency as a principle, and for quantum mechanics itself quantum contingency remains, to the last, in an "unknowable dimension".
